subject.claim: Qurtubi's eighth enumerated interpretation identifies al-Kawthar with al-ithar and attributes it to Ibn Kaysan.

other_open_tafsir_prs.title: Tafsīr 108: Tabari source and staging-lifecycle reconciliation

rows.span: الثامن : أنه الإيثار ; قاله ابن كيسان

source_anchors.source: Arabic Language Academy in Cairo, al-Mu'jam al-Wasit entry آثَرَ
source_anchors.evidence: Defines آثَرَه إيثارًا as choosing/prefering him, and gives the usage آثره على نفسه.
source_anchors.evidentiary_scope: Supports the lexical base of choice/preference and an idiomatic example of preferring someone over oneself; it does not independently establish the intended object or ethical nuance of Qurtubi's bare noun phrase.

source_anchors.source: King Saud University Qurtubi tafsir, Surah al-Kawthar 108:1, page 602
source_anchors.locator: page header line 8; eighth listed opinion line 43
source_anchors.evidence: The Qurtubi witness lists al-ithar as opinion eight and attributes it to Ibn Kaysan.
source_anchors.evidentiary_scope: Confirms wording/order/attribution in this digital Qurtubi witness; not a critical-edition collation or authentication of Ibn Kaysan's identity.

source_anchors.locator: tafsir_entries ids 13239 and 38030; exact span/markers documented in live_read_only
source_anchors.evidence: Arabic row carries the named report; English row has none of the checked attribution or lexical gloss markers.
source_anchors.evidentiary_scope: Confirms a current bilingual-row difference only; it does not approve an English insertion.

finding.confirmed: The live Arabic names Ibn Kaysan as the reporter/authority for this enumerated interpretation; the KSU Qurtubi witness aligns on the named attribution and list order. The Cairo Academy dictionary supports a lexical base of choosing/preferring.
finding.bounded_inference: A controlled paraphrase such as 'preference for another' may be considered, but the bare clause does not itself name the object. 'Selflessness', 'altruism', and 'preferring another over oneself' add contextual nuance and remain proposed glosses for human review.
finding.voice: Qurtubi is enumerating a view attributed to Ibn Kaysan. No oral transmission route or isnad is stated in this clause; none is inferred. This is not labeled as Qurtubi's own preferred interpretation.
finding.english_absence: The corresponding English entry presently lacks the checked attribution/gloss. Preserve that absence until a human scholar approves a sourced translation decision.
finding.edition_boundary: No other-edition opinion has been imported.

actions.staging: This checkpoint is the only proposed repository change in this run; stored on the existing draft PR branch.

next_bounded_step: Ask an independent scholarly reviewer to assess whether a minimal English rendering preserves the reported status and whether the object implicit in al-ithar may be supplied. Until then retain the staged absence. After that, continue with Q04H named-voice ambiguity.
